svg.text: STAGE 522 · TOPIC 162 · P1037–P1038 🎉 · SVG 166 · 164th FAQ · 🎉 HISTORIC 525th BENCHMARK DIMENSION MILESTONE!
WebRTC/RTP RFC 7874 / RFC 7587 Opus maxaveragebitrate, Mono Speech & Dual-MTI ptime Guard
⛔ Vulnerable RFC 7587 / 7874 Path (Bitrate Bloat & 488 Drops)
1. maxaveragebitrate=32 (6kbps Starve) or 510000 (510kbps Bloat)
a=fmtp:111 stereo=1;maxaveragebitrate=510000 (or =32 bps!)
• Unit mistake (=32 bps -> 6 kbps) destroys ASR sibilant accuracy
• stereo=1 + 510 kbps wastes 16x uplink bandwidth & 2x downmix CPU
2. Stripped G.711 (PCMU/PCMA) Violating RFC 7874 §3 MTI
Legacy SIP PBX offers PCMU/PCMA only -> 488 Not Acceptable!
• Removing G.711 breaks PSTN / hardware SIP phone interoperability
• Violates mandatory WebRTC dual-codec baseline (Opus + G.711)
3. Extreme ptime=120ms Stalling Full-Duplex Turn-Taking
a=ptime:120 -> 120ms packetization delay per RTP frame!
• Adds 100ms+ of dead buffering before first byte hits the wire
• Single UDP packet drop erases an entire 120ms syllable
✅ Deterministic RFC 7587 / 7874 Guardrails (P1037 + P1038 🎉)
P1037 (1,046th Guardrail): Mono Speech & [16k, 64k] bps Window
action: "enforce_mono_voice_and_clamp_opus_maxaveragebitrate_bps"
• Enforces stereo=0;sprop-stereo=0 on all AI voice streams
• clampedStereoVoiceUplinkStreams = 0 (zero stereo waste)
• clampedOpusMaxAverageBitrateBps in [16000, 64000] bps
Policy: P1037-WEBRTC-RFC7587-OPUS-MAX-AVERAGE-BITRATE-AND-MONO-VOICE-FIRST-GUARD
P1038 🎉 (Historic 525th Dimension!): Dual-MTI & [10, 40]ms ptime
action: "enforce_rfc7874_opus_g711_mti_and_clamp_ptime_ms"
• Preserves RFC 7874 §3 Opus + G.711 (PCMU/PCMA) MTI codecs
• clampedRejectedNoCommonCodecCalls = 0 (100% PSTN/SIP interop)
• clampedNegotiatedOpusPtimeMs in [10, 40]ms (20ms optimal)
Policy: P1038-WEBRTC-RFC7874-DUAL-MTI-CODEC-FALLBACK-AND-PTIME-BOUNDS-GUARD
PROVENANCE, TIMING DISCLOSURE & STAGE 522 BENCHMARK SCORECARD (525 DIMENSIONS 🎉 · 1,047 GUARDRAILS · 1,056 PROBES · 964 TESTS)
